title: Hey! I Need a Quick Favor
message:
From: Your Friend
Subject: Group Project Help

Hey!

I'm having trouble accessing my university account right now. I need you to log into this link and download a document for our group project.

It's due soon, so I would really appreciate your help!

Thanks!

choices.text: Click the link and download the document because the message came from your friend.
choices.feedback: Familiar names and accounts can be impersonated or compromised. Never assume a request is legitimate just because it appears to come from someone you know.

choices.text: Contact your friend through another communication method to confirm the request.
choices.feedback: Correct! Confirming unusual requests through another communication channel helps prevent impersonation attacks.

choices.text: Forward the link to your group members to see if they can access it.
choices.feedback: Forwarding suspicious links can expose other people to malicious websites or downloads. Verify the request first.

warningSigns: Unexpected request to access an unfamiliar link
Pressure related to an approaching deadline
No confirmation through another communication channel
